process_steps.input_state: raw materials (Mg ingot 99.9%, Mg-25Nd, Mg-30(Gd,Y,Zr) master alloys)

evidence.quote: The alloy smelting was conducted in an electromagnetic induction furnace at the smelting temperature of 750 /C14 C with the soaking time of 15 min, and the casting temperature of 730 /C14 C.
the solution temperature was 535 /C14 C for 6 h, and the alloy was quenched with hot water after being taken out of the furnace
a blast drying oven was used for aging treatment with an aging temperature of 225 /C14 C for 14 h, and the alloy was air-cooled after discharge from the furnace
